query:
-- Joanna Hackett (174442448959) is at Radancy slot 1
-- She is free at slots 5,6,9,10,11,12 (not a session host at those times)
-- Find Radancy delegates at those slots who are free at slot 1 (not booked elsewhere at slot 1)
SELECT 
  m.timeSlot as radancySlot,
  CASE m.timeSlot
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Wed 14:45' WHEN 6 THEN 'Wed 15:15'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Thu 13:15' WHEN 10 THEN 'Thu 13:45'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'Thu 14:30' WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu 15:00'
  END as slotTime,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.id as meetingId
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName = 'Radancy'
AND m.timeSlot IN (5,6,9,10,11,12)
AND m.attendeeId NOT IN (
  SELECT attendeeId FROM meetings WHERE timeSlot = 1
)
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
